question: For each network status, show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding, along with the total number of ports (restricted to standard attributes where RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports') for that same status; also list, for the matching port status, each device owner’s port count and the earliest standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH network_security_stats AS (
    SELECT
        n.status AS network_status,
        VARIANCE(nsb.port_security_enabled) AS port_security_variance,
        STDDEV(nsb.port_security_enabled) AS port_security_stddev
    FROM networks AS n
    INNER JOIN networksecuritybindings AS nsb ON n.id = nsb.network_id
    GROUP BY n.status
),
port_totals AS (
    SELECT
        n.status AS network_status,
        COUNT(p.id) AS total_port_count
    FROM networks AS n
    INNER JOIN ports AS p ON p.network_id = n.id
    INNER JOIN standardattributes AS sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
    WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    GROUP BY n.status
),
port_owner_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.status AS port_status,
        p.device_owner,
        COUNT(p.id) AS owner_port_count,
        MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated_at
    FROM ports AS p
    INNER JOIN standardattributes AS sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
    WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner
)
SELECT
    ns.network_status,
    ns.port_security_variance,
    ns.port_security_stddev,
    pt.total_port_count,
    pos.device_owner,
    pos.owner_port_count,
    pos.earliest_updated_at
FROM network_security_stats AS ns
INNER JOIN port_totals AS pt ON ns.network_status = pt.network_status
INNER JOIN port_owner_stats AS pos ON pt.network_status = pos.port_status
ORDER BY ns.network_status, pos.device_owner;

SELECT n.status AS network_status,
       VARIANCE(nsb.port_security_enabled) AS variance,
       STDDEV(nsb.port_security_enabled) AS stddev,
       COUNT(p.id) AS total_ports,
       p.device_owner AS device_owner,
       COUNT(p.id) AS owner_port_count,
       MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated_at
FROM networks n
JOIN networksecuritybindings nsb ON nsb.network_id = n.id
JOIN ports p ON p.network_id = n.id
JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id AND sa.resource_type = 'ports'
GROUP BY n.status, p.device_owner
ORDER BY n.status, p.device_owner;

  SELECT
    n.status AS network_status,
    VARIANCE(nsb.port_security_enabled) AS port_security_variance,
    STDDEV(nsb.port_security_enabled) AS port_security_stddev
  FROM networks AS n

  GROUP BY n.status
),
port_totals AS (
  SELECT
    p.status AS port_status,
    COUNT(p.id) AS total_port_count
  FROM ports AS p
  INNER JOIN standardattributes AS sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
  GROUP BY p.status
),

  SELECT
    p.status AS port_status,
    p.device_owner,
    COUNT(p.id) AS owner_port_count,
    MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated_at
  FROM ports AS p
  INNER JOIN standardattributes AS sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
  GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner
)
SELECT
  ns.network_status,

  ns.port_security_stddev,
  pt.total_port_count,
  pos.device_owner,
  pos.owner_port_count,
  pos.earliest_updated_at
FROM network_stats AS ns
INNER JOIN port_totals AS pt ON ns.network_status = pt.port_status
INNER JOIN port_owner_stats AS pos ON pt.port_status = pos.port_status
